context: Evaluates correct use of the static trading system prompt exported from the open-nof1.ai package. The solution must import and use the prompt string, which configures the AI model for cryptocurrency analysis with specific output format requirements including RECOMMENDATION format, technical/fundamental analysis guidance, and risk management instructions.

checklist.name: Correct import
checklist.description: The solution correctly imports the trading system prompt constant from the open-nof1.ai package (from lib/ai/prompt.ts)

checklist.name: RECOMMENDATION format
checklist.description: The prompt string contains the required **RECOMMENDATION: [BUY/SELL/HOLD]** output format specification

checklist.name: Technical analysis guidance
checklist.description: The prompt includes guidance on technical indicators including RSI, MACD, moving averages, and support/resistance levels

checklist.name: Risk and position sizing
checklist.description: The prompt includes requirements for risk level, stop loss, take profit targets, and position size guidance
